AM-GM forces universal margin <=1/k with flat-modulus equality rigidity. Difference-set character orthogonality verifies all zero-shift values. Hilbert-Schmidt Weyl diagonalization and Parseval prove the exact eigen-spectrum and sharp full/traceless condition numbers. The Singer line-in-F_(q^3) construction covers all prime powers q. The included checker reproduces four exact ordered-difference sets and numerical spectra; separate dense singular-value calculation matched v=7.

It reveals a mathematically motivated contrast: Singer Gabor frames have relatively large maximum coherence yet optimal minimum ambiguity intensity among sparsest fiducials, reaching >=7/8 of a global SIC benchmark even in infinitely many composite cyclic dimensions.
